villagerretaliation.reputation.label: Reputation
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.gu: Courage under pressure and appetite for risk.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.pr: Practical capability, precision, and tool handling.
villagerretaliation.profile.attribute.ki: Patience, generosity, and care for others.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.farmin: Crop care, harvest timing, and farm tool handling.

Farming reflects how well a villager manages crops from planting to harvest. Higher farming skill supports stronger agricultural trades, better produce-related stock, and steadier growth through regular fieldwork and profession trading.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.fishin: Fishing technique, watercraft, and aquatic supplies.

Fishing measures comfort with rivers, lakes, boats, nets, and aquatic supplies. Villagers with higher fishing skill are better suited for water-focused trade stock and tend to feel more specialized around seafood, tackle, and travel by water.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.smithi: Metalwork, armor, weapons, and durable equipment.

Smithing covers forged tools, metal fittings, armor work, and weapon-making. As smithing rises, villagers can unlock sturdier gear, better equipment-focused offers, and more advanced profession results tied to workshop craftsmanship.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.crafti: General making, repair, and workshop problem solving.

Crafting represents broad hands-on making ability rather than one narrow specialty. It supports flexible workshop output, repairs, practical utility goods, and the kind of general production skill that improves many everyday village trades.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.tradin: Deal sense, supply curation, and merchant judgment.

Trading reflects a villager's instinct for worthwhile deals, stock selection, and merchant timing. Higher trading skill helps shape better curated offers and supports the rarer or more valuable trade options a villager can grow into over time.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.medici: Healing knowledge, remedies, and support supplies.

Medicine measures knowledge of healing, treatment, tonics, and practical care. Villagers with stronger medicine skill lean into support-oriented goods, restorative supplies, and the calmer judgment needed for remedy-focused profession work.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.archer: Bowcraft, aiming, fletching, and ranged equipment.

Archery covers bows, arrows, fletching quality, and ranged discipline. A higher archery skill points to better arrow-related stock, more capable ranged equipment handling, and stronger access to precision-focused trade specialties.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.guardi: Protective instincts, defense, and combat readiness.

Guarding reflects readiness to protect people, respond to threats, and stay steady under pressure. Villagers with better guarding skill trend toward defensive gear, practical protection supplies, and a stronger combat-oriented village role.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.cookin: Food preparation, preservation, and nourishing meals.

Cooking measures preparation skill, ingredient judgment, preservation, and meal quality. As cooking improves, villagers can feel more distinct around prepared foods, nourishing trade items, and the everyday craft of turning raw supplies into useful meals.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.animal: Care for livestock, mounts, and village animals.

Animal Handling represents experience with livestock, mounts, breeding, and day-to-day care. Higher skill here suggests better comfort around animal-related goods and village work tied to keeping creatures healthy, calm, and productive.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.cartog: Mapmaking, landmarks, routes, and exploration planning.

Cartography covers maps, route memory, landmarks, and the ability to turn travel knowledge into something useful. A villager with strong cartography skill is better positioned for navigation-focused stock, exploration tools, and world-aware trade specialties.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.schola: Books, lore, research, and careful study.

Scholarship reflects study, record-keeping, books, lore, and careful learning. Higher scholarship helps define villagers who trade in knowledge, written materials, and more refined profession goods that come from patience and understanding rather than brute labor.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.gather: Foraging, useful materials, and local resource sense.

Gathering measures a villager's eye for useful natural materials, forage, and local resource opportunities. Strong gathering skill supports more reliable access to wild goods, practical ingredients, and village supplies sourced from the surrounding land.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.masonr: Stonework, clay, bricks, and durable building materials.

Masonry reflects comfort with stone, clay, brickwork, and durable structural materials. As masonry improves, villagers become better suited for solid building-focused stock and sturdier profession output rooted in construction skill.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.mining: Ore sense, quarry work, and reading stone for useful materials.

Mining measures extraction knowledge, ore sense, quarry work, and the patience to read stone well. Higher mining skill supports better raw material access, excavation-themed stock, and profession growth tied to underground resource work.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.leathe: Leather gear, saddles, dyes, and animal-work supplies.

Leatherworking covers hide treatment, stitched gear, saddles, dyes, and practical animal-work equipment. Villagers with higher leatherworking skill feel more specialized around flexible gear, tack, and crafted supplies made from treated materials.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.diplom: Negotiation, tact, and keeping village business smooth.

Diplomacy reflects tact, negotiation, social judgment, and the ability to keep village dealings smooth. Strong diplomacy helps a villager feel more capable in coordination-heavy roles and supports trades shaped by trust, communication, and measured decision-making.
villagerretaliation.profile.skill.surviv: Travel sense, danger awareness, and practical resilience.

Survival measures resilience, route sense, danger awareness, and practical decision-making away from home. A villager with strong survival skill is better framed for expedition supplies, tough travel goods, and specialties shaped by making it through harsh conditions.

text.config.villagerretaliation.title: Villager Retaliation Config
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.d: Show Village Bounds
Shows tracked village POI-section outlines and the village name while you are inside. Disabled by default.
Highlight Raid Defenders
Makes every loaded villager still tracked as a Player Raid defender glow. Disabled by default.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.g: Enable Villager Drops
Enables VillagerRetaliation custom adult villager drops.
Enable Wandering Trader Drops
Enables VillagerRetaliation custom wandering trader drops.
Enable Villager Retaliation
Enables temporary villager retaliation behavior.
Enable Villager Reputation
Enables persistent per-villager, per-player reputation memory.
Enable Vanilla Gossip Integration
Allows reputation events to supplement vanilla villager gossip where integration is available.
Enable Despised Kill On Sight
Allows villagers who personally DESPISE a player to target that player on sight.
Despised Kill On Sight Interrupts Hired Work
Allows DESPISED reputation to interrupt an active hired job. Disabled by default; direct attacks can still trigger self-defense.
Reputation Change Display Mode
Where villager reputation tier change messages appear: HUD, Chat, or Off.
Reputation Change Notification Style
Visual style used by HUD reputation change notifications.
Reputation Change HUD Position
Where the HUD reputation change feed is anchored on screen.
Collapse Reputation Change Notifications
Combines same-type villager reputation tier notifications into one counted line.
Show Villager Name Tags
Server-controlled toggle for rendering generated villager names above their heads.
Villager Stat Display
Controls which villagers show health and armor beneath their name: all villagers, hired villagers, party villagers in your party, or none.
Villager Reputation Hover Tooltip Requires Emerald
Requires the player to hold an emerald before the villager reputation hover tooltip appears.
Show Trade GUI Reputation Icon
Shows the villager reputation icon and tooltip in the merchant trade screen.
Enable Villager Death Messages
Allows named villager death messages to be broadcast when vanilla death messages are enabled.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.d: Enable Interaction Screen
Opens Villager Retaliation's interaction screen before adult villager trading.
Shift Right Click Bypasses Interaction Screen
Allows sneaking while right-clicking an adult villager to bypass the interaction screen and open normal trading.
Enable Dialogue Reputation Effects
Allows villager dialogue choices to apply small reputation changes.
Enable Dialogue Camera Focus
Enables client-side camera zoom and villager-facing focus while the Villager Retaliation dialogue screen is open.
Enable Dialogue Cinematic Bars
Shows black cinematic bars while the villager interaction screen is open.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Height
Pixel height of each black cinematic bar on the villager interaction screen.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Min Slant
Lowest horizontal-edge slant in pixels sampled when a villager interaction opens. Negative values lower the left side.
Dialogue Cinematic Bar Max Slant
Highest horizontal-edge slant in pixels sampled when a villager interaction opens. Positive values lower the right side.
Animate Dialogue Cinematic Bars
Moves the black bars in and out with the villager interaction screen.
Enable Forced Dialogue
Enables event-driven forced dialogue such as witnessed retaliation and watched-container confrontations.
Enable Container Forced Dialogue
Enables watched-container forced dialogue and theft/opening chat.
Enable Container Open Reaction
When true, villagers can react immediately when watched containers are opened. Disable this to keep theft and breaking reactions without the opening interjection.
Enable Retaliation Forced Dialogue
Enables forced dialogue and combat barks when villagers begin retaliation.
Enable Player Item Proximity Forced Dialogue
Enables forced dialogue and chat callouts when nearby players carry matching held or worn items.
Separate Villager Chat Messages
Adds a blank chat line between consecutive villager dialogue messages for readability.
Separate Villager Chat Speakers
Adds a blank chat line before a villager dialogue header when the speaker changes.
Interaction Chat Position
Where chat is anchored while the Villager Retaliation interaction menu is open.
Dialogue Text Speed
How quickly villager dialogue appears in the interaction menu. Click the dialogue text area to reveal the current line instantly.
Enable Dialogue Blip Audio
Plays quiet blips as villager dialogue text appears in the interaction menu.
Dialogue Blip Volume
Volume for the dialogue blip sound played while villager text appears.
Dialogue Blip Min Pitch
Lowest random pitch used for each dialogue line's blip sound.
Dialogue Blip Max Pitch
Highest random pitch used for each dialogue line's blip sound.
Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount
FOV zoom amount used by forced dialogue and dialogue entries that explicitly force the camera toward a villager.
Enable Normal Dialogue Camera Focus
Lets regular villager conversations softly turn and zoom the camera toward the villager.
Normal Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount
FOV zoom amount for regular villager conversations. Forced dialogue still uses Dialogue Camera Zoom Amount.
Dialogue Camera Transition Ticks
Ticks used to ease into the dialogue FOV zoom.
Freeze Villager During Dialogue
Stops villager navigation while a Villager Retaliation dialogue conversation is active.
Max Dialogue Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a dialogue conversation closes.
Max Forced Dialogue Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a forced dialogue conversation closes.
Container Forced Dialogue Trigger
When watched containers should trigger forced dialogue: THEFT_ONLY waits until items are removed, OPENING triggers as soon as the container is opened.
Container Watch Mode

Which containers can trigger watched-container dialogue: GENERATED_LOOT_ONLY only watches generated loot tables listed under data/*/generated_containers, ALL_WATCHED_CONTAINERS also watches blocks in #villagerretaliation:watched_containers without loot tables.
Dialogue Positive Reputation Cooldown Days
Minimum Minecraft day changes between positive dialogue reputation gains for the same player and villager.
Repeated Question Positive Limit
Consecutive Question dialogue uses that can still grant positive reputation before the villager gets tired of it.
Trusted Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Trusted villagers get annoyed.
Respected Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Respected villagers get annoyed.
Revered Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Revered villagers get annoyed.
Royalty Repeated Dialogue Limit Bonus
Extra repeated dialogue uses allowed before Royalty-tier villagers get annoyed.
Repeated Question Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when the player keeps repeating Question dialogue after the positive limit.
Repeated Dialogue Option Reset Ticks
Game ticks before repeated dialogue option usage resets. Usage also resets at the start of each Minecraft day.
Gift Annoyance Reduction Divisor
Positive gift reputation value needed to reduce repeated dialogue annoyance by one use. Set to 0 to disable gift annoyance reduction.
Max Follow Distance
Maximum player-to-villager distance in blocks before a following villager stops following.
Greeting Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible friendly greeting.
Question Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible question.
Story Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible story interaction.
Joke Reputation Gain
Reputation gained when a joke lands well.
Joke Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when a joke lands badly.
Insult Reputation Loss
Reputation lost from an insult.
First Greeting Reputation Gain
Reputation gained from an eligible first greeting.
First Insult Reputation Loss
Reputation lost when the first conversation starts with an insult.

Enables idle villager murmurs near players.
Enables villager damage and death alert world-text indicators.

Enables the gift flow in the Villager Retaliation interaction screen.

Allows revered and royalty-tier villagers to occasionally give the player reward gifts.

Enable Villager Moods

Enable Social Attribute Behavior

Allows Social Attributes to shape temporary villager mood intensity and decay.
Enable Social Attribute Dialogue Effects

Reputation at or above this value is REVERED unless ROYALTY.
Respected Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is RESPECTED unless REVERED.
Trusted Threshold
Reputation at or above this value is TRUSTED unless RESPECTED.
Suspicious Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is SUSPICIOUS unless lower.
Hostile Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is HOSTILE unless DESPISED.
Despised Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is DESPISED unless FEARED.
Feared Threshold
Reputation at or below this value is FEARED.
Witness Radius
Radius in blocks for witnessed reputation events.
Gossip Radius
Radius in blocks for villager-to-villager reputation gossip.
Despised Sight Radius
Radius in blocks for DESPISED kill-on-sight checks.
Reputation Decay Enabled
Enables lightweight pruning of old neutral reputation entries.
Reputation Decay Interval
Tick interval for reputation maintenance.
Reputation Decay Amount
Reserved amount for future active reputation decay.
Prune Neutral Entries After Days
Old neutral entries are pruned after this many Minecraft days.
Witness Reputation Requires Line Of Sight
When true, witnessed reputation changes require line of sight.
Enable Reputation Trade Pricing
When true, per-villager reputation dynamically adjusts trade prices for that player.
Reputation Trade Price Scale
Multiplier converting mod reputation into vanilla-style special price adjustments.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.t: Enable Skill Trade Overhaul
When true, villager skill ranks add profession-specific quality and specialty trade offers.
Disable Villager Wallet Limit
When true, villagers have unlimited currency storage and wallet balance never blocks trades.
Enable Special Orders
When true, high-reputation players can place targeted Special Orders for targetable skill-trade definitions.
Special Order Min Reputation
Minimum per-villager reputation tier needed to place Special Orders.
Special Order Wait Days
Default Minecraft days before an accepted Special Order becomes ready when a trade entry does not override wait_days.
Special Order Cooldown Days
Default Minecraft days before the same player can place another Special Order with the same villager when a trade entry does not override cooldown_days.
Special Order Extra Cost Enabled
When true, Special Order request metadata can charge an extra item cost when the request is accepted.
Special Order Max Active Per Player
Maximum active Special Orders each player can have with one villager at a time.
Skill Trade Quality Scaling
When true, skill trade entries with quality_scaling enabled adjust count, base emerald cost, stock, rare chance, XP, and enchantment quality by skill rank.
Skill Trade Low-Skill Penalties
When true, low skill ranks can reduce skill trade counts, stock, rare chance, and increase base emerald costs for quality-scaled entries.
Skill Trade Max Enchantment Level
Maximum enchantment level used by skill-based trade rewards.
Skill Trade Rare Chance Multiplier
Multiplier applied to rare skill-based offer chances.
Skill Trade Allow High-Tier Equipment
Allows Expert and Master smithing/crafting trades to offer diamond-tier equipment.
Skill Trade Allow Special Arrows
Allows high Archery fletcher trades to offer spectral arrows.
Skill Trade Allow Rare Specialty Trades
Allows rare Master-level skill specialty offers such as saddles, nautilus shells, and golden apples.
Enable Skill Growth From Trading Levels
When true, villagers gain small profession skill increases once per newly reached vanilla trade level.
Enable Regular Trade Skill Growth
When true, normal villager trades add slow fractional progress toward the villager's primary profession skill.
Regular Trade Skill Growth Amount
Primary profession skill XP per completed normal trade before daily and repeated-offer diminishing returns.
Enable Skill-Based Trade Leveling
When true, a villager's primary profession skill slows or restores vanilla villager trade-level XP gain.
Skill-Based Trade Leveling Min Multiplier
Villager trade-level XP multiplier at the lowest primary profession skill. XP-bearing trades still grant at least 1 visible trade-level XP.
Skill-Based Trade Leveling Max Multiplier
Villager trade-level XP multiplier at the highest primary profession skill. Keep at 1.0 for high-skill villagers to level at vanilla speed.
Enable Skill Growth Feedback
Shows a subtle actionbar message to the trading player when a villager improves a skill through trade growth.
Skill Growth Primary Min
Minimum point-equivalent XP bonus granted through normal progression at a trade-level milestone.
Skill Growth Primary Max
Maximum point-equivalent XP bonus granted through normal progression at a trade-level milestone.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.d: Show Villager Reputation Debug Overlay
Renders per-villager reputation toward the local player above villager heads. Disabled by default.
Reputation Debug Overlay Max Distance
Maximum distance in blocks for the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Tier
Shows the reputation tier in the debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Number
Shows the reputation number in the debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Health
Shows current and maximum health under the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Show Armor
Shows the current armor value under the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Require Advanced Tooltips
Requires advanced tooltips (F3+H) for the reputation debug overlay.
Reputation Debug Overlay Only When Sneaking
Requires the local player to be sneaking for the reputation debug overlay.
text.config.villagerretaliation.option.c: Enable Villager Sleep Healing
When enabled, villagers that successfully sleep through the night recover up to the configured health threshold after waking.
Villager Sleep Healing Max Health Percent
Maximum fraction of a villager's health restored after successful sleep. Villagers already above this threshold are not harmed.
Weaponsmiths Fight Back
Allows weaponsmiths to retaliate with stronger melee behavior.
Toolsmiths Fight Back
Allows toolsmiths to retaliate with melee behavior.
Armorers Fight Back
Allows armorers to retaliate and gain short defensive resistance.
Fletchers Fight Back
Allows fletchers to retaliate, including simple ranged shots.
Butchers Fight Back
Allows butchers to retaliate with melee behavior.
Villagers Target Hostile Mobs
Allows adult villagers to proactively target visible hostile mobs.
Wandering Traders Target Hostile Mobs
Allows wandering traders to proactively target visible hostile mobs.
Villagers Retaliate Against Hostile Mobs
Allows adult villagers damaged by hostile mobs to fight back. Disable to keep monster encounters closer to vanilla fleeing behavior.
Wandering Traders Retaliate Against Hostile Mobs
Allows wandering traders damaged by hostile mobs to fight back.
Villagers Stand Ground Against Hostile Mobs
Allows armed villagers to suppress vanilla panic and stand their ground against hostile mobs. Disable if villagers should usually keep fleeing monsters.
Villagers Flee Visible Creepers
Makes villagers avoid visible creepers instead of trying to fight them.
Villagers Pick Up Ground Weapons
Allows villagers to pick up nearby dropped weapons while threatened.
Wandering Traders Pick Up Ground Weapons
Allows wandering traders to pick up nearby dropped weapons while threatened.
Natural Hostile Target Radius
Maximum range in blocks for villagers and wandering traders to proactively target visible hostile mobs. The explicit hostile mob targeting toggles must also be enabled.
Combat Weapon Drop Chance
Chance for temporary retaliation main-hand weapons to drop on villager death.
Combat Weapon Enchant Chance
Chance for temporary retaliation main-hand weapons to be enchanted (hard mode only).
Armorer Shield Chance (Hard)
Chance for armorers to spawn with an offhand shield (hard mode only).
Clerics Use Potions
Allows clerics to retaliate defensively and use regeneration when hurt.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Range
Maximum range in blocks for idle clerics to look for injured villagers or wandering traders.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Health Threshold
Health ratio below which idle clerics consider an ally injured enough to heal.
Passive Cleric Ally Heal Requires Line Of Sight
When true, idle clerics only heal allies they can already see, preventing long wall-hugging path attempts.
Hostile Tier Harass Throw Enabled
Allows villagers who view a player as HOSTILE or worse to occasionally throw harmless eggs or poisonous potatoes.
Hostile Tier Harass Throw Min Interval Ticks
Minimum ticks between hostile-tier harassment throws.
Hostile Tier Harass Throw Max Interval Ticks
Maximum ticks between hostile-tier harassment throws.

Allows wandering traders to drop a safe copy of one current trade result.

When true, villager chat ignores animated and styled dialogue text effects and renders as normal chat text for this client.
